context_requirements: Active NF-kB signaling, either constitutive (e.g., KRAS/EGFR-driven, NFKBIA/NFKBIB loss) or cytokine/TLR-inducible
Expression of the drug's direct target (RELA, IKBKB, or other NF-kB pathway component)
For strong proximal transcriptional effects, cells must have measurable basal NF-kB-dependent gene expression
falsifiers: No decrease in NF-kB-dependent genes (e.g., NFKBIA, CXCL2, CCL2, ICAM1) at 6 h in any responsive line
No increase in NFKBIA/NFKBIB/NFKBIE feedback genes at 6 h
No difference in response between NF-kB-dependent lines (A549, HT29, PC3) and NF-kB-independent lines (MCF7, HA1E)
Predominant upregulation of NF-kB target genes rather than downregulation
No transcriptional response at either 6 h or 24 h in all nine lines
